responsibility: Implements the frontend AVR calling-convention policy used by rustc/LLVM integration by classifying aggregate arguments and returns as indirect and leaving non-aggregates direct in the target FnAbi.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/avr.rs`, this file does not describe AVR register names or asm modifiers; it implements rustc's current AVR frontend ABI policy, mainly deciding when aggregates become indirect for calls and returns.
